$comment: PLACEHOLDER RECORDS — the agreement templates. Stands in for GET /api/v1/admin/agreements/templates and /{id}. A TEMPLATE IS NOT AN AGREEMENT: this is the wording, written once; an Agreement is one copy of it sent to one member, with the body COPIED IN at send. That copy is the whole point — a signature over a body that can still change is not a signature, so editing a template here bumps its `version` and never touches anything already out there. `clauses[]` is ordered and the order is the order it is read in. `{{name}}` and `{{date}}` are the only placeholders; they are filled at send from the member and the day, and anything else is left as typed rather than silently blanked.

templates.title: NDA · 2026
templates.purpose: Confidentiality, for everyone with access to client work.

clauses.heading: What this covers
clauses.text: This agreement is between Interior Bazzar and {{name}}, and it takes effect on {{date}}. It covers everything you see, hear or are given access to in the course of your work here that is not already public.

clauses.heading: What you agree to
clauses.text: You will not share client drawings, quotations, pricing, supplier terms or customer contact details with anyone outside the company, and you will not keep copies after you leave.

clauses.heading: What is not covered
clauses.text: Anything already public, anything you knew before you joined, and anything a court or regulator requires you to disclose. Tell us before you disclose under that last one, if you are allowed to.

clauses.heading: How long it lasts
clauses.text: Two years from your last working day. Client material stays confidential for as long as the client requires it.

templates.title: Offer letter
templates.purpose: The written offer, signed before a start date is confirmed.

clauses.heading: The offer
clauses.text: Interior Bazzar is pleased to offer {{name}} the role described in your appointment letter, on the terms below. This offer is made on {{date}} and is open for seven days.

clauses.heading: Pay and review
clauses.text: Your salary is as stated in your appointment letter, paid monthly. It is reviewed once a year, in April.

clauses.heading: Hours and place
clauses.text: Standard hours are eight a day, five days a week, at the location named in your appointment letter. Hybrid arrangements are agreed with your reporting manager.

clauses.heading: Notice
clauses.text: Thirty days on either side, once your probation is complete. Fifteen during probation.

clauses.heading: Accepting
clauses.text: Type your full name below to accept. Your start date is confirmed once this is signed and your documents are in.

templates.title: Equipment acknowledgement
templates.purpose: Signed when a laptop or phone is handed over.

clauses.heading: What you were given
clauses.text: {{name}} received the equipment listed in the handover record on {{date}}. It stays company property throughout.

clauses.heading: Looking after it
clauses.text: Use it for work, keep it insured against your own negligence, and tell IT the same day if it is lost, stolen or damaged.

clauses.heading: Giving it back
clauses.text: Everything comes back on your last working day, in working order, with company data removed by IT rather than by you.

templates.title: Exit declaration
templates.purpose: Signed on the last day. Not in use yet.

clauses.heading: Confirmation
clauses.text: {{name}} confirms that as of {{date}} all company property has been returned and no company data is retained on personal devices or accounts.
